No email, no letters. Pick a password — we will give you an account number and you are in. The number and the password are your way in.
At least 8 characters, letters and digits.
I agree to the processing of my personal data
The service will not accept this password: at least 8 characters, letters and digits.
Tick the data processing consent — the account cannot be created without it.
The "you are human" check did not pass. Try again or create the account in a browser.
The "you are human" check does not open right now. Try later or create the account in a browser.

Write down the number and the password. We show the number once: the account has no email, so without them there is nothing to restore access with. If you want recovery, add an email in the account cabinet.
The account was created, but we could not sign you in automatically. Write down the number and the password — the sign-in screen opens next with the number already filled in.
Trial access is already on: %1$d days.
By signing in you accept the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
Please verify your email on the website.
Password is correct — enter the code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
This device key belongs to another account and could not be reissued. Try again or contact support.
Your session has expired — please sign in again. This usually happens after a password change.
Tunnel is up but no traffic is passing — please reconnect.
No internet on this phone — check your connection
No traffic — you are not protected
This account is blocked. Contact support: %1$s
This country is temporarily out of capacity. Pick another one — we are adding more.
This country is not included in your plan.
The service is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
Our server is not responding. Your internet works — try again in a minute.
Something went wrong. Try again a bit later.
Enter the email of your account — we\'ll send a reset code. Works only if an email is linked.

This needs the account\'s email: there is nowhere to send a code for a number or a login. If no email is linked, sign in with your number and password and link one in the cabinet — or write to support.
Code sent to your email (if the account exists). Check your inbox.
Enter the code from the email and a new password.
Password changed — sign in with the new one.
Invalid/expired code or password too weak.
Invalid or expired code. Check the email or request a new one.
Password is too weak — at least 8 characters, letters and digits/symbols.
Long-press and drag a country to reorder; the order is saved
The connection will drop and settings on this phone will be erased. You will need your email (or account number) and password to come back. Your account and remaining access stay untouched.
Account %1$s and all of its devices will be deleted permanently. Any remaining access is lost and cannot be restored. Enter your password to confirm.
Wrong password — the account is untouched
Checking that the internet is flowing…
Waiting for the server — a first connection takes up to 15 seconds…
Direct connection refused — trying via Russia…
Not getting through — trying a backup way…
Normally not needed: the app switches to the backup channel by itself when UDP is blocked. Turn on if UDP never works on your network — saves the wait on every connect. Slower than the direct path.
Server not responding — connecting to %1$s with saved settings…
Could not connect. Try again or pick another country
Displays current download/upload speed in the tunnel
A new version %1$s of Mayak is available.
Version %1$s is out and your build has not been updated for three weeks. Newer builds fix what breaks connectivity on some carriers.
Your build is over a month old. We change how connections work more often than that — an old version may stop working entirely. Please update: version %1$s.
Allow installs from this source, then tap Update again
Your build is no longer supported: the connection in it doesn\'t work the way it should. There is no way to continue on this version.
Your account, access and settings are intact — everything comes back right after the update. You won\'t have to sign in again.
The server answered but offered no country to connect to. Usually this is temporary: refresh in a minute. If nothing changes, check your account — the plan may have no countries in it.
The phone has no internet right now, so there was nowhere to fetch the list from. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
Our server didn\'t answer. Countries are most likely fine — it\'s the fetch that failed. Try again in a minute.
Brings IPv6 through the tunnel where your carrier doesn\'t give it. The IPv6 badge lights up only when it really works. Turn off if it causes issues.

Choose apps that go around the VPN over your real IP (e.g. banking, government apps that block foreign IPs). Everything else stays protected. Selected apps are intentionally outside the tunnel — add only what you need.

One tap: Russian apps (banks, government services, marketplaces, streaming) go directly over your real IP, so they work as if you were at home. Everything else stays protected by the VPN. Applies on the next connection.
Russian services will go direct on the next connection
Russian services will now open directly — that\'s how banking and government apps work. You can turn this off in Settings.
Show presets on the home screen
The preset selector and toggle appear above the connect button. Turn off if you don\'t use split-tunnel presets.
Split tunnel: with it on, selected services (Russian ones by default) go direct, bypassing the VPN
The DNS profile is shared by every device on the account (phone, router, dashboard). Change it here; it applies on the next connection.
A plain fast resolver. Nothing is blocked.
Blocks ads and trackers in apps and the browser (AdGuard DNS).
The same plus adult sites and safe search (AdGuard Family).
Your resolver: corporate, family or any public one.
One or two public IP addresses, comma separated, e.g. 1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9
Profile saved. It applies on the next connection
This account has no devices yet.
The device will no longer connect to Mayak and its slot on the account will be freed. The app stays installed there — signing in and connecting again brings it back.
This is the phone you are looking at right now. The current connection will drop and the slot will be freed. To bring it back, just connect again.
Device disconnected, a slot is free now.
The app has switched to the new Mayak server — please sign in again with the same credentials.
Your account already has the maximum number of devices, so this one can\'t be added. Open “My devices”, disconnect one you no longer use, and try again.
Your access to the service has ended, so connecting is unavailable. Renew it in the dashboard and everything will work again.
No plan has been chosen for this account yet, so there is nothing to connect to. Pick a plan in the dashboard and connecting will start working.
Reset all app settings to defaults? This does not sign you out.

Automatically brings up your last working connection when the phone starts or the system launches the VPN — from the config saved on the device, no network needed. Connect once manually first so there is something to restore.

Blocking the internet when the VPN is off is a system setting. Opens Android VPN settings — enable “Always-on VPN” and “Block connections without VPN” for Mayak. Together with Auto-connect above, your traffic never leaves unprotected.
Couldn\'t open system VPN settings on this device. Open Settings → Network → VPN manually.

Ask for your fingerprint, face or device PIN when opening the app. Protects your account, settings and config if the phone is unlocked in someone else\'s hands. Doesn\'t affect the VPN. Applies from the next time you open the app.
Set up a screen lock (PIN/fingerprint) in your phone settings — otherwise there is nothing to check and the lock won\'t work.
The icon and name change in a few seconds. If not, restart the phone. Your VPN connection is not affected.
Email: not linked — you can add one in the cabinet
Tap the big circle and your traffic goes through our server. Tap again to turn protection off.
Pick a country from the list below: if protection is on, the app switches over by itself. The number next to a country is its latency — lower is faster.
The switch at the top keeps banks and government sites on your normal connection, where a foreign address only gets in the way.
A short vibration on taps and when protection turns on or off.
Quote it when you write to support — we will find you faster than by email.

Something not working, or not sure how to set it up? Start here. The help centre answers the common questions; if that is not enough, write to us — the letter is prefilled. A log helps us find the cause faster; data is processed per the privacy policy.

Describe what happened:



—————
We need this to look into it — please keep it:
App: %1$s
Device: %2$s
System: %3$s
Direction: %4$s
Account: %5$s
No mail app on this phone. The support address is copied: %1$s
Describe what is not working. Your plan, access dates, devices and app version we see ourselves — no need to type them.
The reply will come to %1$s and to “My tickets” right here.
The reply will appear in “My tickets” right here.
The list of topics is out of date — update the app. We sent your text as “Other”.
Too short: describe the problem in at least one sentence.
Too long: leave up to %1$d characters, the rest we will discuss in the thread.
Too many messages in a row. You can send again in about %1$d min — what has arrived is already with us.
Too many messages in a row. Try a bit later — what has arrived is already with us.
The form does not work on our side right now. Your text is not lost — send it by mail, the address is below.
It did not go through. The text is kept — press “Try again”.
No connection to the server. The text is kept — try again when the network is back.
Sign in to your account: then we see your plan and devices and answer to the point.
No tickets yet. Write to us above — the reply shows up here (and by email, if one is linked).
The form works after you sign in — then we see your plan and devices and answer to the point. Without signing in, write to us by mail: the address is below.
Couldn\'t send it right now, but the log is saved on your phone. We\'ll retry automatically next time, or you can send the file yourself below.
Sign in first to send a log.
The previous log could not be sent — it is saved on this phone. We will retry on our own; if you would rather not wait, send us the file via any messenger or to %1$s.

A fork of the official AmneziaWG client (amneziawg-android).
Engine: amneziawg-go %1$s.
Protocol: AmneziaWG 2.0 — obfuscated WireGuard.
Based on WireGuard® (not affiliated with or endorsed by WireGuard LLC).
Apache-2.0. © AmneziaWG contributors and WireGuard LLC. Mayak Networks — a fork with custom UI.

Bundled open-source components:

• amneziawg-android — Apache-2.0
• amneziawg-go — MIT
• WireGuard® (underlying protocol) — GPLv2 / various; "based on WireGuard®", not affiliated
• AndroidX libraries — Apache-2.0
• Material Components for Android — Apache-2.0
• ZXing (QR scanning) — Apache-2.0
• kotlinx (coroutines, serialization) — Apache-2.0

Full license texts are available in the respective project repositories.
